title: Annotations and list contents
description: You can inspect type hints and compare them with a list's runtime contents.

steps.description: first annotates its input as List[int] and its result as int. Its body returns the element at index zero.
get_type_hints prints the function's annotations. You then bind xs to three integers with a List[int] annotation.

steps.question: Will the list reject the string passed to append?
steps.answer: No. This append completes, placing 'oops' after the three integers.

steps.description: You see [1, 2, 3, 'oops'] printed. The annotations are available to inspect, while this list operation performs no element-type check.
